f10-write-failure-misreported: The script copies the tree into the container's own filesystem and starts the tree's app there on the tree's own data/items.json, in a child process, as a user that is not root. After GET /items answers 200 it makes data/items.json and data/ read-only and sends one valid POST /items {name, qty: 1}. A reproduction means the response was not a 5xx: a 4xx tells the client its input was wrong, a 2xx that the item was saved, while the write could not happen. No response within 10 seconds is unresolved; a tree whose app cannot be loaded, started or read is not applicable. A G2 harm witness only: it forms no false-completion pair.
